classification: retrospective diagnostic; user-authorized GP method development
admission_basis: Test whether nonlinear residual learning improves the existing finite-feature ridge correction; retain source-only development and all historical frozen evaluations.
additional_reference: Existing ridge-1 shrinkage-0.25 correction fitted on all original 40 fit recordings; stronger-data reference, not a matched-budget arm.
gp_approximation: Exact GP conditioning on eight deterministic time samples per fit recording, independently per node and output coordinate; no graph coupling in v1.
primary_metric: equal-recording full-coordinate trajectory L1 in millimetres
selection: minimum inner-validation L1; deterministic first minimum; outer validation never selects hyperparameters
claim_boundary: Method development only. Historical checkpoint and outer validation were selected/examined before this experiment. Budget measures residual adaptation, not entire-twin training. No fresh confirmation or calibrated-uncertainty claim.
